diagnosis.root_cause: element_abilities.gd declares practice targets as Array[StaticBody3D], duplicates that collection in lightning_target(), then appends CharacterBody3D enemies. The retained runtime element restriction explains the independently observed append failures and prevents ordinary enemy targeting. The tracker finding is separately insufficient coverage: recent wrapped-objective observations returned to their original geometry, but the ordered short-objective and collapse/expand matrix remains incomplete. Its existing readout exposes rectangles without viewport/text-scale correlation, so another speculative height adjustment is unjustified.

Instead, isolate the ordered state matrix and expose missing viewport/scale correlation.
